UGA.note: USRB company registration is named only as a system BIMS and IRAS connect to; nothing says firms register online or what the register holds.
UgNLIS is named only as used for land verification; processing of transactions is not stated.

facts.fact: The National Building Review Board says BIMS and IRAS are integrated with the Uganda National Land Information System (UgNLIS) for land verification.

The National Building Review Board says all local governments can now use BIMS for building control, and that IRAS, developed by the Local Government Finance Commission, automates revenue collection and payment in 166 vote-level local governments.
IRAS automates revenue collection and payment processes in 166 vote-level local governments, according to the National Building Review Board; no total is given.

UGA.note: The text does not state how local government offices are connected.

facts.fact: The National Building Review Board says IRAS automated revenue collection and payment processes in 166 vote-level local governments, and is now the payment gateway for building fees; what it records of payers is not stated.
IRAS is in use in 166 vote-level local governments, according to the National Building Review Board; no total is given.
IRAS was developed by the Ministry of Local Government through the Local Government Finance Commission.
